name: Luna 16

narrator.name: Luna 16
narrator.role: the robot that scoops and flies home

intro: Hello! I'm Luna 16, a robot with a drill and a tiny rocket on my back.
My mission: drill some Moon soil, pack it in a capsule and fire it back to Earth.
I only need ONE day on the surface. Grab and go!
Pick a landing spot where my day goes well.
briefing: We are over Mare Fecunditatis, the Sea of Fertility.
Choose where I land. Remember: I only stay one day.
fact: Luna 16 actually landed in the lunar night and brought back 101 grams of Moon soil.
